verification_policy.rule_role: pre-prescribing screening prompts, not a complete product label
required_before_prescribing: select the exact active ingredient, formulation and route
check the current locally authorised product information or formulary
re-check contraindications, warnings, interactions, age, pregnancy, renal/hepatic dosing and monitoring
record the product/label version and review date

official_label_portals.name: DailyMed (US National Library of Medicine)
official_label_portals.limitation: Contains current in-use labeling submitted to FDA; confirm approval/current FDA label and local applicability.

official_label_portals.name: European Medicines Agency product information
official_label_portals.limitation: Covers officially approved EU product information; confirm that the exact product is included and adapt to Libya.

verification_policy.libya_requirement: A Libyan formulary or locally authorised product label must take precedence when available.

avoid_if: severe active liver disease or prior serious reaction
use_caution_if: heavy alcohol use, malnutrition, low body weight, or concomitant paracetamol-containing products
monitoring: total daily exposure and clinical response

avoid_if: active gastrointestinal bleeding/ulcer, serious NSAID allergy, or NSAID-triggered asthma
use_caution_if: chronic kidney disease, heart failure, hypertension, anticoagulation/antiplatelet therapy, older age, pregnancy, or dehydration
monitoring: renal function, blood pressure, oedema and gastrointestinal bleeding symptoms when clinically indicated

avoid_if: documented immediate or severe delayed penicillin allergy
use_caution_if: renal impairment, prior C. difficile, or recent antibiotic exposure
monitoring: clinical response, allergy and antibiotic-associated diarrhoea

avoid_if: prior serious macrolide allergy or clinically important QT prolongation with interacting drugs
use_caution_if: liver disease, bradycardia, hypokalaemia, myasthenia gravis, pregnancy, or QT-prolonging medicines
monitoring: clinical response; ECG/electrolytes when risk is material

avoid_if: pregnancy, breastfeeding where unsuitable, or tetracycline allergy
use_caution_if: oesophageal disease, liver disease, photosensitivity, or interacting iron/calcium/antacid products
monitoring: clinical response and gastrointestinal/photosensitivity adverse effects

avoid_if: uncontrolled hypertension, severe coronary disease, or monoamine-oxidase inhibitor use
use_caution_if: pregnancy, arrhythmia, glaucoma, urinary retention/BPH, hyperthyroidism, or diabetes
monitoring: blood pressure, palpitations and duration; topical products only briefly to avoid rebound congestion

avoid_if: serious product allergy
use_caution_if: recurrent epistaxis, recent nasal surgery/trauma, glaucoma, or concurrent high-dose corticosteroids
monitoring: nasal irritation/bleeding, growth in children when prolonged, and total steroid burden

avoid_if: ototoxic preparation when the tympanic membrane is perforated or a ventilation tube is present
use_caution_if: diabetes, immunocompromise, prior ear surgery, severe pain or cranial-nerve symptoms
monitoring: response within 48-72 hours and signs of invasive disease

avoid_if: serious oseltamivir allergy
use_caution_if: renal impairment, severe vomiting, or neuropsychiatric history
monitoring: dose adjustment by renal function, clinical response, nausea/vomiting

avoid_if: asthma, COPD, or prior bronchospasm with inhaled powder
use_caution_if: milk-protein allergy or inability to use inhaler correctly
monitoring: bronchospasm and clinical response

avoid_if: serious product allergy
use_caution_if: recurrent oral candidiasis, dysphonia, high cumulative steroid exposure, or poor inhaler technique
monitoring: symptom control, exacerbations, inhaler technique, oral effects and growth in children

avoid_if: untreated serious systemic infection unless specialist-directed
use_caution_if: diabetes, severe hypertension, peptic ulcer, osteoporosis, glaucoma, psychiatric history, or recurrent courses
monitoring: glucose, blood pressure, mood, infection and cumulative exposure

avoid_if: serious product allergy
use_caution_if: tachyarrhythmia, ischaemic heart disease, hypokalaemia, urinary retention or narrow-angle glaucoma depending on class
monitoring: heart rate, tremor, potassium when high-dose, symptoms and inhaler technique

avoid_if: pregnancy, prior ACE-inhibitor angioedema for ACE inhibitors, bilateral renal artery stenosis, or severe hyperkalaemia
use_caution_if: chronic kidney disease, dehydration, low blood pressure, or potassium-raising medicines
monitoring: creatinine/eGFR, potassium and blood pressure before and after initiation/titration

avoid_if: class-specific contraindication such as severe hypotension; avoid verapamil/diltiazem in HFrEF
use_caution_if: heart failure, bradycardia/heart block, constipation, oedema, or interacting medicines
monitoring: blood pressure, heart rate, oedema and constipation

avoid_if: anuria or severe electrolyte depletion
use_caution_if: gout, diabetes, hyponatraemia, dehydration, kidney disease, or lithium use
monitoring: electrolytes, renal function, blood pressure, weight and gout symptoms

avoid_if: significant hyperkalaemia or renal function below the product/guideline threshold
use_caution_if: CKD, ACE inhibitor/ARB/ARNI use, potassium supplements, or dehydration
monitoring: potassium and renal function at baseline and after initiation/titration

avoid_if: pregnancy/breastfeeding or active serious liver disease
use_caution_if: prior muscle toxicity, hypothyroidism, heavy alcohol use, renal impairment, or CYP-interacting medicines
monitoring: baseline liver tests; repeat as guideline directs; CK only when muscle symptoms/risk warrant

avoid_if: severe renal impairment below the licensed threshold or acute metabolic acidosis
use_caution_if: acute illness/dehydration, hypoxia, liver failure, heavy alcohol use, contrast studies, or vitamin B12 deficiency
monitoring: eGFR, gastrointestinal tolerance, HbA1c and periodic B12 in at-risk patients

avoid_if: active diabetic ketoacidosis or inability to follow sick-day rules
use_caution_if: recurrent genital infection, volume depletion, low carbohydrate intake, frailty, CKD, pregnancy, or planned surgery
monitoring: renal function, volume status, genital/urinary symptoms; ketones when unwell; temporary withholding during acute illness/fasting/surgery

avoid_if: pregnancy or serious product allergy
use_caution_if: prior pancreatitis, severe gastroparesis, gallbladder disease, dehydration risk, or concurrent insulin/sulfonylurea
monitoring: weight, glucose, gastrointestinal tolerance, hydration and symptoms of pancreatitis/gallbladder disease

avoid_if: chronic malabsorption or cholestasis
use_caution_if: warfarin, ciclosporin, antiepileptics, levothyroxine, kidney-stone risk, or fat-soluble vitamin deficiency
monitoring: weight, gastrointestinal effects, interacting-drug levels and fat-soluble vitamins when prolonged

avoid_if: untreated thyrotoxicosis or uncorrected adrenal insufficiency
use_caution_if: coronary disease, arrhythmia, older/frail patient, pregnancy, or malabsorption
monitoring: TSH after initiation/dose changes and periodically; closer monitoring in pregnancy and cardiac disease

avoid_if: previous severe reaction to the selected antithyroid medicine
use_caution_if: pregnancy trimester, liver disease, baseline neutropenia, or interacting anticoagulation
monitoring: thyroid function; urgent full blood count for fever/sore throat; liver assessment for hepatic symptoms

avoid_if: severe bradycardia, high-grade heart block without pacing, or cardiogenic shock
use_caution_if: asthma/COPD, peripheral vascular disease, diabetes with hypoglycaemia, or acute decompensated heart failure
monitoring: heart rate, blood pressure, bronchospasm and heart-failure symptoms

avoid_if: severe renal/hepatic impairment with strong CYP3A4 or P-gp inhibitor use
use_caution_if: CKD, liver disease, older/frail patient, statin use, macrolides, or neuromuscular disease
monitoring: gastrointestinal toxicity, blood count/CK when toxicity suspected

avoid_if: previous severe hypersensitivity to the selected medicine
use_caution_if: CKD, cardiovascular disease (especially for febuxostat choice), interacting azathioprine/mercaptopurine, or high hypersensitivity-risk ancestry
history_checks: ancestry where HLA testing is recommended
monitoring: serum urate treat-to-target, renal/liver function and urgent review for rash/systemic symptoms

avoid_if: iron overload or anaemia not caused by iron deficiency
use_caution_if: active GI disease, severe constipation, malabsorption, ongoing bleeding, or interactions with levothyroxine/tetracyclines/quinolones/antacids
monitoring: haemoglobin response, ferritin/iron stores and tolerance; investigate failure to respond

avoid_if: hypercalcaemia or vitamin D toxicity
use_caution_if: renal stones, severe CKD, granulomatous disease, hyperparathyroidism, digoxin or thiazide use
monitoring: calcium and 25-hydroxyvitamin D when treating deficiency; renal function in high-risk patients

avoid_if: serious product allergy
use_caution_if: severe hypokalaemia risk during brisk haematologic response, uncertain diagnosis, or folate deficiency
monitoring: clinical and haematologic response; investigate cause; do not delay treatment for neurological compromise

avoid_if: concurrent PDE-5 inhibitor or riociguat use, or severe hypotension
use_caution_if: aortic stenosis, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy, volume depletion or recurrent syncope
monitoring: blood pressure, symptom frequency and headache; emergency action if pain persists

avoid_if: active major bleeding or serious aspirin allergy for aspirin
use_caution_if: ulcer history, anticoagulation, thrombocytopenia, asthma sensitive to aspirin, renal disease, or older/frail patient
monitoring: bleeding symptoms and haemoglobin when indicated

avoid_if: active major bleeding, mechanical heart valve, or anticoagulant-specific contraindication
use_caution_if: renal/liver impairment, prior GI/intracranial bleed, frailty/falls, interacting medicines, pregnancy, or adherence concern
monitoring: renal/liver function at guideline intervals, haemoglobin, bleeding and adherence; use licensed dose criteria

avoid_if: serious product allergy
use_caution_if: long-term use, osteoporosis risk, low magnesium/B12/iron, C. difficile risk, severe liver disease, or clopidogrel interaction for some PPIs
monitoring: response and ongoing indication; magnesium/B12/iron or bone risk when clinically indicated

avoid_if: use of clarithromycin- or levofloxacin-containing empiric therapy without susceptibility/local-resistance justification
use_caution_if: penicillin allergy, pregnancy, QT risk, liver/renal disease, prior macrolide/fluoroquinolone exposure, or anticoagulation
monitoring: adherence/adverse effects and mandatory test of cure using an accepted method after the recommended washout

avoid_if: bloody diarrhoea, high fever, suspected invasive infection/C. difficile, ileus, toxic megacolon, or young child without specialist direction
use_caution_if: liver disease, acute ulcerative colitis flare, dehydration, or uncertain diagnosis
monitoring: stop if worsening pain/distension, fever, blood or lack of improvement

avoid_if: suspected bowel obstruction, perforation, or acute surgical abdomen
use_caution_if: faecal impaction, severe dehydration, CKD for magnesium/phosphate products, electrolyte disturbance, or swallowing difficulty for bulk fibre
monitoring: stool response, hydration and electrolytes when risk/product warrants

avoid_if: serious product allergy
use_caution_if: undiagnosed rectal bleeding, infection, prolonged corticosteroid exposure, pregnancy, hypotension or headache depending on agent
history_checks: PDE-5 inhibitor use for topical nitrate
monitoring: short duration for steroid/anaesthetic products; symptom response and local adverse effects

avoid_if: no absolute contraindication when anaphylaxis is suspected; do not withhold because of cardiac disease or pregnancy
use_caution_if: beta-blocker use or significant cardiac disease does not remove the emergency indication but requires specialist planning
history_checks: ability to use and access two in-date devices
monitoring: training, expiry dates, carriage and emergency action-plan understanding

avoid_if: previous serious reaction to the selected antihistamine
use_caution_if: renal/hepatic impairment, pregnancy, glaucoma/urinary retention for anticholinergic agents, sedation-sensitive work or driving, or other sedatives
monitoring: sedation, anticholinergic effects and symptom response

avoid_if: active major bleeding, pregnancy except specialist-defined indications, or inability to provide safe INR monitoring
use_caution_if: high bleeding risk, liver disease, poor adherence, unstable diet/alcohol intake, falls, or interacting medicines/antibiotics
monitoring: INR at protocol-defined intervals, bleeding, interactions and time in therapeutic range

avoid_if: no absolute disease-wide exclusion when insulin is urgently required; selection must be clinician-directed
use_caution_if: recurrent hypoglycaemia, renal/hepatic impairment, frailty, irregular meals, driving, cognitive impairment, or concomitant glucose-lowering medicines
monitoring: glucose/HbA1c, hypoglycaemia, weight, injection technique and sick-day management

avoid_if: serious reaction to the selected agent
use_caution_if: renal impairment, older/frail patient, or clinically important interacting medicines
monitoring: symptom response, renal-adjusted dosing and adverse cognitive effects where relevant

avoid_if: serious reaction to the selected product
use_caution_if: significant renal or heart disease, sodium restriction, electrolyte disorder, or medicines with absorption interactions
monitoring: short-term response; separate interacting medicines according to product guidance

avoid_if: active serious liver disease when combined with a statin, or serious product reaction
use_caution_if: pregnancy, hepatic impairment, prior muscle symptoms, ciclosporin, warfarin, or concomitant statin/fibrate
monitoring: lipid response, liver tests when combined/indicated, and muscle symptoms

avoid_if: agent-specific contraindication or serious product reaction
use_caution_if: pregnancy, hepatic/renal impairment, gout for bempedoic acid, injection reaction risk, or major interacting therapy
monitoring: lipid response and agent-specific adverse effects under formulary/specialist protocol

avoid_if: untreated thyrotoxicosis or uncorrected adrenal insufficiency
use_caution_if: coronary disease, arrhythmia, older/frail patient, pregnancy, osteoporosis, or concomitant thyroid hormone
monitoring: TSH and thyroid hormones, pulse/ECG when indicated, symptoms and bone/cardiac adverse effects

avoid_if: unsafe oral route because of shock, ileus, altered consciousness or persistent uncontrollable vomiting
use_caution_if: heart failure, advanced renal disease, severe electrolyte disturbance, diabetes, or need for precisely controlled fluids
monitoring: hydration, urine output, weight and electrolytes when clinically indicated

avoid_if: active serious hypersensitivity to the selected preparation
use_caution_if: active infection, pregnancy trimester, severe liver disease, prior infusion reaction, or phosphate-depletion risk
monitoring: observed infusion reaction, haemoglobin/iron response and phosphate for preparations/risk groups where indicated

avoid_if: agent-specific serious reaction or mechanical bowel obstruction
use_caution_if: glaucoma, urinary retention/prostatic obstruction, constipation, tachyarrhythmia, pregnancy, older/frail patient, or anticholinergic burden
monitoring: symptom response, constipation, urinary retention, vision/cognitive adverse effects

avoid_if: recent myocardial infarction, significant conduction disorder, uncontrolled mania, or concomitant MAOI
use_caution_if: suicide/overdose risk, epilepsy, glaucoma, urinary retention, constipation, older/frail patient, pregnancy, QT-prolonging or serotonergic medicines
monitoring: response, mood/suicidality, anticholinergic effects, blood pressure and ECG when risk warrants; taper rather than abrupt cessation

avoid_if: agent-specific serious reaction
use_caution_if: renal impairment, osteoporosis/bone risk, pregnancy, HIV coinfection, decompensated cirrhosis, or prior antiviral resistance
monitoring: HBV DNA, ALT, renal/bone parameters by agent, adherence and hepatocellular-carcinoma surveillance when indicated; avoid unsafe abrupt withdrawal

avoid_if: unresolved major interaction or regimen contraindication
use_caution_if: decompensated cirrhosis, HBV coinfection/reactivation risk, pregnancy considerations, severe renal disease, prior DAA failure, or interacting acid suppressants/statins/anticonvulsants/herbals
monitoring: adherence, liver safety where indicated and sustained virologic response testing after treatment

avoid_if: hypercalcaemia or serious product reaction
use_caution_if: renal stones, CKD, hyperparathyroidism, cardiovascular risk, constipation, or interactions with levothyroxine/iron/bisphosphonates/selected antibiotics
monitoring: calcium and renal/stone risk when indicated; avoid unnecessary high total intake

avoid_if: uncontrolled asthma or inability to manage anaphylaxis risk in an appropriate specialist setting
use_caution_if: pregnancy initiation, beta-blocker/ACE-inhibitor use, cardiovascular disease, prior systemic reaction, or adherence/access limitations
monitoring: specialist-observed reactions, asthma control, adherence and emergency preparedness

avoid_if: suspected pyelonephritis/systemic infection, significant renal impairment below the current product threshold, previous nitrofurantoin lung/liver injury, or serious allergy
use_caution_if: pregnancy near term, G6PD deficiency, anaemia, pulmonary or hepatic disease, peripheral neuropathy, older/frail patient, or repeated/prolonged courses
monitoring: clinical response, renal eligibility, and pulmonary/hepatic/neurological symptoms; reassess promptly if systemic symptoms develop

avoid_if: serious trimethoprim allergy, severe folate-deficiency blood disorder, or pregnancy when contraindicated by the selected product/local guideline
use_caution_if: renal impairment, hyperkalaemia risk, folate deficiency, older/frail patient, or ACE inhibitor/ARB/MRA/potassium/methotrexate interaction
monitoring: clinical response; potassium, renal function and blood count when risk or duration warrants

avoid_if: previous serious cephalosporin reaction; avoid selected beta-lactam if cross-reactive severe allergy risk is unacceptable
use_caution_if: renal impairment, prior severe penicillin reaction, previous C. difficile, recent antibiotics, or seizure risk with selected high-dose agents
monitoring: clinical response, allergy, renal-adjusted dosing and antibiotic-associated diarrhoea

avoid_if: previous serious quinolone reaction or previous disabling/long-lasting fluoroquinolone adverse effect
use_caution_if: pregnancy, children unless specialist indication, tendon disorder/corticosteroid use, aortic aneurysm risk, QT prolongation, myasthenia gravis, seizure/neuropathy, renal impairment, diabetes, or interacting cations/medicines
monitoring: stop and seek review for tendon, neurological, psychiatric, severe glucose or aortic symptoms; monitor response and renal dosing

avoid_if: serious aminoglycoside allergy or inability to provide required drug-level/renal monitoring
use_caution_if: renal impairment, dehydration, older/frail patient, hearing/vestibular disease, myasthenia gravis, pregnancy, or other nephrotoxic/ototoxic medicines
monitoring: serum drug concentrations per protocol, creatinine/eGFR, urine output and auditory/vestibular toxicity

avoid_if: severe respiratory depression, acute severe asthma without monitoring, paralytic ileus, or serious product reaction
use_caution_if: older/frail patient, sleep apnoea/COPD, renal/hepatic impairment, pregnancy, constipation, falls, substance-use history, or sedative/gabapentinoid/alcohol use
monitoring: sedation, respiratory rate, pain response, constipation, nausea and duration; use the shortest appropriate course

avoid_if: symptomatic severe hypotension or serious product reaction
use_caution_if: postural hypotension/syncope, falls, cataract surgery, PDE-5 inhibitor/other antihypertensive use, hepatic/renal impairment, or pregnancy when used off-label for stones
monitoring: blood pressure, dizziness/falls, symptom response and ejaculatory adverse effects; alert cataract surgeon

avoid_if: pregnancy exposure to crushed/leaking product or serious product reaction
use_caution_if: liver disease, planned PSA interpretation, sexual/fertility concerns, depression history, or suspected prostate cancer
monitoring: symptoms and adverse effects; PSA must be interpreted in light of therapy; response is delayed and requires scheduled review

avoid_if: urinary retention, gastric retention, uncontrolled narrow-angle glaucoma, or serious product reaction
use_caution_if: high post-void residual/obstruction, cognitive impairment, older/frail patient, constipation, autonomic neuropathy, QT risk, or anticholinergic burden
monitoring: voiding/retention, cognition, constipation, dry mouth, vision and symptom response

avoid_if: hyperkalaemia, severe renal impairment, untreated Addison disease, delayed gastric emptying/obstruction, or serious product reaction
use_caution_if: ACE inhibitor/ARB/MRA/potassium use, heart disease, active UTI with selected salts, gastrointestinal ulceration risk, or sodium/potassium restriction
monitoring: serum potassium/renal function and urine pH/stone-risk parameters according to the prevention plan

avoid_if: serious fosfomycin reaction or use for suspected upper/systemic UTI where adequate renal-tissue treatment is required
use_caution_if: significant renal impairment, pregnancy, recurrent/complicated infection, or high sodium load for selected IV formulations
monitoring: clinical response, gastrointestinal adverse effects and culture-directed reassessment

avoid_if: severe uncontrolled hypertension for mirabegron or serious product reaction
use_caution_if: hypertension, tachyarrhythmia/QT risk, urinary retention/obstruction, renal/hepatic impairment, pregnancy, or interacting CYP medicines depending on agent
monitoring: blood pressure, pulse, urinary retention and symptom response
